effects: Exactly `assets` USDC moves from the signer to the vault (SafeERC20Lib.safeTransferFrom(asset, msg.sender, address(this), assets) in enter).
sdUSDCv2 vault shares go to `onBehalf`. The vault works out how many with previewDeposit(assets) at the current share price. There is no minimum.
formats.shown: The screen reads 'Deposit 1 USDC for <onBehalf>'. Fields show the USDC amount, a fixed 'Share ticker: sdUSDCv2' line and the address that gets the shares.

findings.title: deposit: the number of shares minted is set by the vault price and appears nowhere.
findings.evidence: VaultV2.sol deposit: `uint256 shares = previewDeposit(assets); enter(assets, shares, onBehalf);`. The shares come from storage (totalAssets/totalSupply), not from calldata. The descriptor has only 'Share ticker' (a constant), with no amount. Case 0 minted 1e18 sdUSDCv2 to 0xdead.
findings.fix: No calldata field can show it. Optionally add a note that the vault price sets the share amount.

findings.title: deposit: the 'Share ticker' constant field and the 'Deposit asset' label for an amount add little.
findings.evidence: descriptor deposit fields: {label:'Share ticker', format:'raw', value:'$.metadata.constants.vaultTicker'} and {path:'assets', label:'Deposit asset'}. Screen case 0: 'Share ticker: sdUSDCv2' with no amount next to it.
findings.fix: Label the amount 'Amount to deposit'. Put the share token in the intent ('Deposit USDC for sdUSDCv2 shares') instead of a separate raw field.

cases.notes: 1 USDC left the signer, as shown. The shares were minted to 0xdead (signer null), and the screen shows that recipient correctly.

formats.key: withdraw(uint256 assets, address receiver, address onBehalf)
effects: sdUSDCv2 shares are burned from `onBehalf`. The vault works out how many with previewWithdraw(assets) at the current share price (deleteShares(onBehalf, shares)).
Exactly `assets` USDC goes from the vault to `receiver` (SafeERC20Lib.safeTransfer(asset, receiver, assets)).
When the signer is not `onBehalf`, the owner's share allowance to the signer drops by the shares burned.
formats.shown: The screen reads 'Withdraw 2222 USDC to <receiver>'. Fields show the exact USDC amount, the receiver and the owner whose shares are used.

findings.title: withdraw: the screen never states the sdUSDCv2 shares burned from the owner, nor their amount.
findings.evidence: VaultV2.sol withdraw: `uint256 shares = previewWithdraw(assets); exit(...)` → `deleteShares(onBehalf, shares)`. Case 1: 2215.300496489873148508 sdUSDCv2 left the signer (signer out). The screen has only 'Withdraw exactly 2222 USDC', 'To' and 'Owner'.
findings.fix: The amount comes from storage and cannot be shown. The intent could say shares are burned, e.g. 'Withdraw {assets} by burning sdUSDCv2 shares of {onBehalf}'.

cases.notes: The 2222 USDC received is shown correctly. The reader knew vault shares leave but not how many (2215.30 sdUSDCv2), and the screen cannot state that amount.

formats.key: redeem(uint256 shares, address receiver, address onBehalf)
effects: Exactly `shares` sdUSDCv2 are burned from `onBehalf`. When the signer is not `onBehalf`, the owner's allowance to the signer drops by the same amount.
USDC goes from the vault to `receiver`. The vault works out how much with previewRedeem(shares) at the current share price. There is no minimum.
formats.shown: The screen reads 'Redeem 5999.14 sdUSDCv2 to <receiver>'. Fields show the share amount, the receiver and the owner. It never says which asset comes back.

findings.title: redeem: the screen never says USDC is the asset sent to the receiver.
findings.evidence: VaultV2.sol exit: `SafeERC20Lib.safeTransfer(asset, receiver, assets)` with asset = USDC (immutable 0xa0b8...eb48). Case 2: 6013.259671 USDC arrived at the signer (signer in). The screen shows only 'Shares to redeem', 'To' and 'Owner'. The blind reader wrote 'likely USDC; amount not shown'. The descriptor already has the underlyingTicker constant but never uses it.
findings.fix: Name the asset in the intent, e.g. interpolatedIntent 'Redeem {shares} for USDC to {receiver}' or intent 'Redeem sdUSDCv2 for USDC'.

findings.title: redeem: the USDC amount received is set by the vault price, with no minimum.
findings.evidence: VaultV2.sol redeem: `uint256 assets = previewRedeem(shares);`. It is computed from storage, and the calldata has no minimum. Case 2: 6013.259671 USDC was received and does not appear on screen.
findings.fix: No descriptor change can show it. It is a limit of ERC-4626 redeem.

cases.notes: The share burn is shown exactly. The USDC received appears nowhere: neither the asset nor the amount. The reader guessed USDC.

summary.worst: redeem: the screen never says USDC is the asset sent to the receiver.
